description: Apply-ExcelOperation of office-com-host.ps1: every one of the 46 operations with the argument sets of the live Excel tests and every refusal, Korean-UI colour number formats and typed-text cases ("1-2", "007"), charts of every type including plotBy rows and highlight, freeze panes in a small hidden window, autofit with wrapped and merged rows, page setup with fit and margins, and batches in background and live mode with a failure mid-batch so the checkpoint restore runs. Not covered, which need an install only the migration PC can supply: a non-Korean UI language for the colour-name fallback (the host knows the Korean table only) and an Excel on a machine without a printer driver (the page-setup fallbacks).

scenarios.description: set_cell (text, number, boolean, null, a formula), set_formula with and without '=', set_range (a block that fills its range, uneven rows, a block over 500 cells), append_row on an empty sheet and below data, clear_cell, replace_text across sheets.
Texts Excel would type as dates, numbers, booleans or errors stay text under the cell's previous number format: single cells and one block, with a formatted cell and a mixed-format block.

add_sheet (appended after the last sheet), copy_sheet with and without a name, rename_sheet, delete_sheet, set_sheet_visibility (visibility word and visible flag), protect_sheet with allowances, unprotect_sheet, define_name, delete_name, and the refusals of sheet names and defined names.

set_style: fonts, size, bold, italic, colours, a fill and a fill taken away (null), every alignment name, indent with and without an alignment of its own, wrap, lock, borders per side and uniform with inside lines and a cleared side, Korean-UI colour number formats; merge_cells, unmerge_cells.

insert and delete rows and columns with counts, row and column visibility by letter and number, row heights and column widths (counts, refusals outside the range), notes, provenance appended once, delete_note, hyperlinks.

add_image by cell and by points with alternative text, set_drawing by name and by position, delete_drawing, and the refusals (no drawing named, no property to set, a drawing that is not there). The picture is the 1 x 1 PNG of the ppt-read inputs.

add_chart of every type (column, bar, stacked_column, stacked_bar, line, area, pie, doughnut, scatter, a number code), plotBy rows with a header row of years, a frame by cell and toColumn, fontName, a title, seriesColors for series and for slices, showValues with a label position, a colour and a number format, legend on and off, zeroBaseline, gridlines and valueAxis off, highlight by index and by text with mutedColor, and the refusals.

add_table with and without a name and style ('none' clears the style), sort_range by letter, by header and by first column ascending and descending with and without a header, add_conditional_format (expression, colorScale of two and three points, dataBar), delete_conditional_formats, add_validation (a literal list, a cell range list, whole with two bounds, custom), add_pivot_table, set_autofilter, and the sort refusals (a hidden row, a merged cell, a key outside the range).

freeze_panes (a row, a column, both, none, a header low enough that a small hidden window would freeze short), set_sheet_view (gridlines, zoom clamped to 10-400), autofit_range (columns, rows only, wrapped cells, merged rows, a minWidth floor, a lone title line), set_page_setup (fit, margins in inches, orientation, print area, fitToContent, centring, print title rows and its refusal), set_header_footer (every slot and token and its refusals).

values: Title of the report that is long

scenarios.description: A batch in a background session whose second operation fails: the checkpoint is restored and the failure names the operation.
The same failing batch in a live session: one undo unit is taken back for the whole batch.
A batch of editing operations in a live session (freeze panes, sheet view, page setup, autofit: the ones that touch the window).
